findings.highlight: Gilgamesh’s natural enemy is Archer’s magic
findings.evidenceJa: ギルガメッシュの宝具の天敵は、アーチャーの魔術
findings.governingReading: Archer’s Magecraft is the natural counter to Gilgamesh’s Noble Phantasms
findings.explanation: A weapon-system matchup becomes a claim that Archer’s magic is the natural enemy of Gilgamesh himself.

findings.highlight: You said you’re going to fight him
findings.evidenceJa: そんなふざけたコト口走ったワケ
findings.governingReading: you blurted out something that ridiculous
findings.explanation: Rin’s incredulous judgment of Shirou’s unsupported proposal disappears.

findings.highlight: UhI didn’t have any proof
findings.evidenceJa: ういや
findings.governingReading: Uh—no, I just did not have proof
findings.explanation: Missing punctuation fuses Shirou’s hesitation to the pronoun.

findings.highlight: I might have the best luck against him
findings.evidenceJa: 俺たちの中なら一番俺に可能性がある
findings.governingReading: of everyone here, I have the best chance
findings.explanation: A reasoned relative chance becomes luck.

findings.highlight: would be a complete match for him
findings.evidenceJa: 互角の戦いをせざるを得ない
findings.governingReading: is forced to fight Heroic Spirit Emiya on even terms
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s inability to avoid an even matchup is reduced to a static comparison.

findings.highlight: I can barely manage to project one
findings.evidenceJa: 一本投影するだけでボロがでる
findings.governingReading: even projecting one of Archer’s swords makes my flaws show
findings.explanation: Evidence that Shirou’s copy breaks down is changed into difficulty completing it.

findings.highlight: that magicthat Reality Marble
findings.evidenceJa: あの魔術固有結界
findings.governingReading: that Magecraft—the Reality Marble
findings.explanation: Missing punctuation fuses the classification to its apposition.

findings.highlight: that magic
findings.evidenceJa: あの魔術
findings.governingReading: that Magecraft
findings.explanation: The technical category is again called magic.

findings.highlight: the ultimate forbidden magic
findings.evidenceJa: 禁呪中の禁呪
findings.governingReading: a forbidden spell among forbidden spells
findings.explanation: A superlative within Magecraft is reclassified as magic.

findings.highlight: both stem from your Reality Marble
findings.evidenceJa: 固有結界から漏れた物にすぎない
findings.governingReading: are merely things leaking out of your Reality Marble
findings.explanation: The specific model of Strengthening and Projection as leakage is generalized to shared origin.

findings.highlight: I’m sure it’ll be a piece of cake
findings.evidenceJa: 驚くぐらい簡単に歯車がかみ合うと思う
findings.governingReading: I think the gears will mesh with surprising ease
findings.explanation: Rin’s qualified mechanical prediction becomes cocky certainty and trivializes the risk.

findings.highlight: I have to do something about the insufficient part.
findings.evidenceJa: 足りない分は、わたしがなんとかするしかない
findings.governingReading: I have no choice but to cover the shortfall myself
findings.explanation: Rin’s reluctant personal commitment to supply the missing mana becomes vague problem-solving.

findings.highlight: blushes furiously, her voice trailing off to a whisper
findings.evidenceJa: 頬を染めて、横目で、しおらしい小声で
findings.governingReading: blushing, glancing sideways, in an unusually demure little voice
findings.explanation: The multi-part portrayal of Rin’s vulnerable manner is reduced to an unsupported intensity of blushing.

findings.highlight: TTohsaka, that’s
findings.evidenceJa: と遠坂、それは
findings.governingReading: T-Tohsaka, that is—
findings.explanation: Missing punctuation fuses Shirou’s stammer.

findings.highlight: only a few ways
findings.evidenceJa: 一つか二つぐらい
findings.governingReading: only one or two methods
findings.explanation: The deliberately narrow technical count is generalized.

findings.highlight: ways for magi to tune in
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師同士が波長を合わせる
findings.governingReading: methods by which magi align their wavelengths
findings.explanation: The mechanism of matching magical wavelengths becomes vague colloquial tuning.

findings.highlight: connect with her
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂と霊脈を繋いで
findings.governingReading: connect a spiritual or magical pathway with Tohsaka
findings.explanation: The concrete channel through which mana will pass disappears.

findings.highlight: so that I can use her magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: その魔力を分けて貰う
findings.governingReading: receive a share of her mana
findings.explanation: Rin’s act of sharing mana becomes Shirou simply using it.

findings.highlight: My head explodes.
findings.evidenceJa: 頭が、一撃で粉砕された
findings.governingReading: my head is pulverized in a single blow
findings.explanation: The comic metaphor’s sudden external-impact structure is generalized.

findings.highlight: got attracted to her even more anyway
findings.evidenceJa: 一段と惹かれちまった赤いあくま
findings.governingReading: the red devil to whom I became still more attracted
findings.explanation: Shirou’s affectionate “red devil” framing of Rin disappears.

findings.highlight: much easier than fighting with your life on the line
findings.evidenceJa: 殺し合いよりはずっと楽
findings.governingReading: far easier than killing one another
findings.explanation: Rin’s dry comparison with mutual lethal combat becomes generic personal risk.

findings.highlight: dozens of yellow cards
findings.evidenceJa: イエローカードをダースで
findings.governingReading: a dozen yellow cards
findings.explanation: The singular dozen is inflated into multiple dozens.

findings.highlight: embracing eachother naked
findings.evidenceJa: 裸で抱き合う
findings.governingReading: embracing each other naked
findings.explanation: Missing spacing fuses the reciprocal pronoun.

findings.highlight: my body is going against my will
findings.evidenceJa: 体は正反対だった
findings.governingReading: my body was reacting in precisely the opposite way
findings.explanation: The contrast between Shirou’s words and desire becomes a struggle against volition.

findings.highlight: her shoulders
findings.evidenceJa: 首から肩までのライン
findings.governingReading: the line from her neck to her shoulders
findings.explanation: A specific bodily contour disappears.

findings.highlight: gorgeous thighs
findings.evidenceJa: 瑞々しい太もも
findings.governingReading: fresh, supple thighs
findings.explanation: Shirou’s sensory image is replaced by generic praise.

findings.highlight: if It’ll help us match Gilgamesh
findings.evidenceJa: それでギルガメッシュに対抗できて
findings.governingReading: if it will let us counter Gilgamesh
findings.explanation: Improper capitalization and contraction disrupt the internal justification.

findings.highlight: I frantically restrain myself with my reasoning.
findings.evidenceJa: 必死に理性を修復する
findings.governingReading: desperately repair my reason just before losing control of myself
findings.explanation: Shirou’s near-collapse and effort to restore rational control become awkward restraint by “reasoning.”

findings.highlight: You don’t want to do it with me, Shirou?
findings.evidenceJa: 士郎は、わたしじゃイヤ？
findings.governingReading: Shirou, is it no good if it is me?
findings.explanation: Rin’s broader fear that Shirou rejects her is narrowed to unwillingness to perform the act.

findings.highlight: why are you asking such an impossible thing
findings.evidenceJa: 絶対にあり得ないコトを心配そうに訊く
findings.governingReading: why ask so anxiously about something that could never be true
findings.explanation: The impossibility belongs to Rin being unwanted, not to the legitimacy of her question.

findings.highlight: That’s enough to kill me
findings.evidenceJa: それだけでも銃殺もの
findings.governingReading: that alone is grounds for execution by firing squad
findings.explanation: Shirou’s exaggerated self-condemnation loses its specific comic image.

findings.highlight: if that’s the only way that’ll let us beat him
findings.evidenceJa: それでヤツに勝てる可能性が生まれるなら
findings.governingReading: if doing so creates a possibility of beating him
findings.explanation: A newly created chance becomes the sole possible method.

findings.highlight: I shouldn’t have panicked
findings.evidenceJa: 迷ってる場合じゃなかった
findings.governingReading: this was no time to hesitate
findings.explanation: Shirou’s indecision becomes panic.

findings.highlight: explained to you in detail
findings.evidenceJa: 順を追って説明すべきだった
findings.governingReading: explained things in order, step by step
findings.explanation: Rin regrets the abrupt sequence, not insufficient detail.

findings.highlight: even though I’m cornered
findings.evidenceJa: 息もできないぐらい追い詰められている
findings.governingReading: though he is pressed so hard he cannot breathe
findings.explanation: The bodily extremity under which Shirou corrects Rin disappears.

findings.highlight: This is like a dream come true.
findings.evidenceJa: こんなの、それこそユメみたいだ
findings.governingReading: this is truly like a dream
findings.explanation: The scene’s unreality is promoted into explicit wish fulfillment.

findings.highlight: Butthat’s exactly why
findings.evidenceJa: けどだからこそ
findings.governingReading: But that is exactly why
findings.explanation: Missing spacing fuses the conjunction.

findings.highlight: I manage to say it.
findings.evidenceJa: 頭は言葉を紡ぐ
findings.governingReading: somehow, his head continues spinning words
findings.explanation: The strange contrast between Shirou’s burning face and independently articulate mind disappears.

findings.highlight: I wanted to do it with you with nothing else in the way.
findings.evidenceJa: そういうのを抜きで触れ合いたかった
findings.governingReading: I wanted to touch and be close to you without those contractual conditions
findings.explanation: Shirou’s desire for intimacy apart from the mana contract is narrowed into wanting sex.

findings.highlight: Then.
findings.evidenceJa: と。
findings.governingReading: And then—
findings.explanation: The connective is stranded as a one-word English sentence immediately before the kiss.

findings.highlight: Speaks with a smile
findings.evidenceJa: いたずらに、これ以上ないって仕草で笑って
findings.governingReading: smiles with unsurpassably mischievous playfulness
findings.explanation: The defining playful reversal in Rin’s expression is reduced to a malformed neutral stage direction.

findings.highlight: Speaks with a smile that rattles my brain
findings.evidenceJa: こっちの頭をグラグラにしてくれた
findings.governingReading: with that smile, she leaves my head reeling
findings.explanation: The English fragment loses Rin as the acting subject of the closing beat.
